Book correction: In this part the book's print has slips: the definition line misses the sign "=" between f(-x) and f(x), and the example prints (-x)^{2} = x. The correct lines are: f(-x) = f(x) f(-x) = (-x)^{2} = x^{2} = f(x)
Book correction: The book prints (-x)^{3} = -x. The cube of -x is -x^{3}, so the line should read: f(-x) = (-x)^{3} = -x^{3} = -f(x)
